qpq_ui_compute_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:chartered_conquest }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_target value = scope:secondary_recipient }
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_term value = 96 }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_payer_tier value = qpq_chartered_conquest_payer_tier_value }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_agent_tier value = qpq_chartered_conquest_agent_tier_value }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_chartered_conquest_price_value }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_price value = scope:qpq_price }

		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_price value = scope:qpq_price }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_ask value = qpq_favourable_omens_ask_value }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_offers value = qpq_favourable_omens_offer_points_value }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_total value = qpq_favourable_omens_ai_acceptance_value }
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				exists = scope:secondary_recipient
			}
			set_variable = qpq_ui_target_ok
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:consecration_rites }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_term value = 12 }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_payer_tier value = qpq_consecration_rites_payer_tier_value }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_agent_tier value = qpq_consecration_rites_agent_tier_value }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_consecration_rites_price_value }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_price value = scope:qpq_price }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_ask value = qpq_consecration_rites_ask_value }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_offers value = qpq_consecration_rites_offer_points_value }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_total value = qpq_consecration_rites_ai_acceptance_value }
		if = {
			limit = {
				always = yes
			}
			set_variable = qpq_ui_target_ok
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:qpq_ui_kind = flag:temple_patronage }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
			set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_target value = scope:secondary_recipient }
		}
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_term value = 12 }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_payer_tier value = qpq_temple_patronage_payer_tier_value }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_agent_tier value = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = qpq_price value = qpq_temple_patronage_price_value }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_price value = scope:qpq_price }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_ask value = qpq_temple_patronage_ask_value }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_offers value = qpq_temple_patronage_offer_points_value }
		set_variable = { name = qpq_ui_acc_total value = qpq_temple_patronage_ai_acceptance_value }
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:secondary_recipient
				exists = scope:secondary_recipient
			}
			set_variable = qpq_ui_target_ok
		}
	}
}

qpq_ui_clear_derived_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_agent_init
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_target }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_target
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_target_ok }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_target_ok
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_payer_tier }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_payer_tier
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_agent_tier }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_agent_tier
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_price }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_price
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_term }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_term
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_acc_ask }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_acc_ask
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_acc_offers }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_acc_offers
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_acc_total }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_acc_total
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_acc_other }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_acc_other
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = qpq_ui_fail_0 }
		remove_variable = qpq_ui_fail_0
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_ui_candidates }
		clear_variable_list = qpq_ui_candidates
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_ui_title_candidates }
		clear_variable_list = qpq_ui_title_candidates
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable_list = qpq_ui_artifact_candidates }
		clear_variable_list = qpq_ui_artifact_candidates
	}
}
